newsitem.title: USA: Cytyc Corp seeks approval for new approach.
newsitem.headline: Cytyc Corp seeks approval for new approach.

text.p: Cytyc Corp said on Thursday it is seeking regulatory approval to allow women with inconclusive or borderline cervical-cancer diagnoses to be tested for human papillomavirus (HPV) from the same sample collected for Cytyc's pap test.

Cytyc submitted a pre-market approval application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for these patients to be tested for HPV from the single cervical sample collected for the ThinPrep pap test, allowing doctors to classify them as normal or abnormal without requiring another office visit.

"The ability to conduct HPV typing immediately following an inconclusive or equivocal pap test result should provide doctors with a much clearer indication of how best to manage these women," said Cytyc spokesman Michael Adams in a statement released by the company.
